title: Props are read-only: don't change them

slides.say: Props can change over time. But a component must never change its own props.

slides.text: A parent can pass new props on every render, like a time that ticks each second.
slides.say: Props are not always static. A clock can get a new time prop every second. Props reflect the data at any point in time.
But props are immutable. Do not overwrite them inside the child.

slides.text: Need a change? The child asks the parent for new props, a new object. For user input, set state.
slides.say: To change, the child asks its parent to pass different props, a whole new object. To respond to the user, you set state.
